---
name: Documentation PR Template
---

## Description

Summarize the documentation change.
Explain what was added, updated, reorganized, or removed — and why it improves the docs.

## Type of Change

- New page or major addition
- Update to existing page
- Navigation or structure improvement
- Content cleanup (grammar, clarity, rewriting)
- Refactoring (no functional changes)
- Fix for inaccurate or outdated information
- Refactor of docs organization (no content change)
- Other (explain below)

## Testing / Validation

- Viewed changes in local dev server
- Verified internal/external links work
- Checked formatting, headings, and code blocks
- Confirmed screenshots or diagrams render correctly

## Checklist

- Content matches project style and terminology
- No broken links
- No spelling or grammar issues
- Navigation and sidebar items are correct
- Metadata is correct (title, description, tags, etc.)
- Updated related pages if needed

## How to Review

Provide clear steps for reviewers, such as:

- Which pages were changed
- Where to navigate to verify the updates
- Any special notes for checking formatting or code examples


## Screenshots / Previews (if applicable)

Attach screenshots, GIFs, or local preview URLs showing the updated documentation pages.

## Additional Notes

Include anything relevant for reviewers — context, follow-up tasks, known limitations, or related issues.
